moves.Bolt Strike: Special Electric attack. 20% chance to paralyze the target.
moves.Charge Beam: 100% chance to raise the user's Sp. Atk by 1 stage.
moves.Covet: Deals damage only; does not steal the target's held item.
moves.Destiny Bond: If the user faints before its next move, the foe that caused it also faints. Can be used on consecutive turns.
moves.Explosion: The user faints after dealing damage. Halves the target's Defense in the damage calculation.
moves.Fusion Bolt: Special Electric attack. Power doubles if Fusion Flare was used earlier this turn.
moves.Leaf Tornado: 30% chance to lower the target's accuracy by 1 stage.
